pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, sub-polygonal dark regions with smooth to slightly blurred edge gradients; geometry is non-uniform with rounded vertices; spatial area of patches is significantly larger than inter-patch corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a topological mesh; nodes consist of tri-radial and quadri-radial junctions; pixel thickness remains relatively constant across the visible neck sections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dark, short-haired mane exhibiting a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the dorsal neck margin; the contour is sharply defined against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, avian-shaped silhouette (consistent with an oxpecker) is attached to the mid-upper neck region, occluding a small portion of the pelage pattern.
